t: Section 212 of the Sugar Act of 1948, as amended, is amended by striking out “sugar or” in clauses (1) and (2) and inserting in lieu thereof “direct consumption sugar or”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that substitutes the phrase "direct consumption sugar or" for "sugar or" in two clauses of the Sugar Act of 1948. It creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue, so no party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a purely textual amendment to a statute, changing the definition or scope of a term ('sugar or' to 'direct consumption sugar or'). It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. It is a legislative change to the law itself, not a procedural requirement for participation.
qwen_block.s: Section 212 of the Sugar Act of 1948, as amended, is amended by striking out “sugar or” in clauses (1) and (2) and inserting in lieu thereof “direct consumption sugar or”.
